_comment: Mission cards (Upgrade Pack). Secret, one per player. Complete EITHER mission -> reveal, choose 1 of 3 ongoing abilities (mark with cube). 'Once per day' abilities use a Power token (flip to X; reset each day). 'cards' = Contact cards on player board. Back: 'Mission'. Texts summarised.

goals: Have 3 cards not including any Bribes or Snitches
abilities: Once per day, you may use a Helipad as if you had a helicopter.
Once per day, avoid one Federal Police Officer.

goals: Have 1 Locker tile and 1 Exit tile.
abilities: Receive an additional $5k during the Income Phase.
Once per day during your turn you may take one Contact card.
Once per day, avoid one SWAT Police Officer.

goals: Visit all buildings in the same group
Have 3 cards without a Notoriety star
abilities: Once per day, use a Contact card without paying for it.
When using a Contact card, pay $2k more to not flip it after use.
Once per day, move one SWAT Police Officer.

goals: Spend 2 Extra actions in one day
abilities: Ignore the presence of other players in Safe Houses.
Change your position in Turn Order with the player in front of you.
Once per day, avoid one County Police Officer.
Treat all City tiles as having Helipads.
You can control Gangs for free.
Once per day, move one Federal Police Officer.
Unlocked Asset tiles with shields can avoid one Police Officer of any type.
Once per day, you may ignore the gain of 1 Notoriety.
Once per day, move one County Police Officer.
